display.purpose: Bold sans-serif heading for the researcher and the three collections.

title.purpose: A paper, talk or CV entry title.

metadata.purpose: Dates, publication years and result counts.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Color and border transitions on buttons when reduced motion has not been requested.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Main action in the academic profile.
components.css: .ds-action{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:2.8rem;padding:.6rem 1.35rem;border:1px solid var(--wine,#7b2d3b);background:var(--wine,#7b2d3b);color:var(--paper,#fafaf7);border-radius:3rem;font:600 .94rem/1.4 var(--body,'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif);text-decoration:none}.ds-action:hover{background:var(--ink,#201f20);border-color:var(--ink,#201f20)}.ds-action:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--wine,#7b2d3b);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-action{transition:color 150ms ease-out,background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out}}
